newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Choong Wae buying back shares.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Choong Wae buying back shares.

text.p: South Korea's Choong Wae Pharmacy Co Ltd said on Monday it would buy back 135,000 shares of its own common stock in the open market between January 17 and April 16 to boost its share price.

The buyback, representing 3.06 percent of its share capital, would be made through Daewoo Securities, Ssangyong Investment and Securities, Daishin Securities and Shinyoung Securities, a Choong Wae statement said.
Buy orders would be placed at the previous day's closing price, it said.
Choong Wae currently does not hold any of its own shares.
Its shares closed Monday's trading at 22,600 won per share, down 300 won on the day.
